ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity field; distinct high-intensity circular annulus (ring) located in the medial region of the left lobe; high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal left and right tips; light-intensity mottling along the inferior/anterior boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated angle of approximately 38 degrees; vertical depth occupies approximately 12-15% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the superior boundary; peak-to-trough amplitudes vary between 4 and 18 pixels; serration is most pronounced and irregular on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward concave sweep toward the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal orientation with terminal vertical flaring.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel aggregates localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; smaller, isolated white circular spots visible along the lower-left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent high-contrast white circular annulus on the mid-left lobe; several faint, short, sub-parallel horizontal white linear disruptions on the lower-left lobe quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural deformation and high-intensity clusters at the fluke tips (consistent with barnacle colonization); distinct circular ring scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The circular annulus on the left lobe is the most distinctive visual identifier outside of standard trailing edge serration patterns.
